name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester), about 5 minutes from LAX.
Open since 1952.
Happy hour is 3–6 every day.
Margaritas are $6 on Tuesdays.
Monday: half off burgers, 11–3.
Tuesday: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas.
Thursday: half off sandwiches, 11–3.
Friday: $3 sliders, 11–3.
Karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs happen every week.
Melody Rewards is free to join, with 100 welcome points.
Earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Rewards: 250 pts soft drink or Melody Fries, 500 pts $10 off, 1,000 pts free starter, 1,500 pts free entrée.
One reward per visit, one prize per day, no stacking.
A reward pass works once and expires 10 minutes after you open it.
Birthday bonus is +250 points once a year.
Referral: +100 points per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
Location bonus: +100 points once.
Just Landed: 10% off your first order today with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.
Melody Approach is the flying game, with Campaign and Survival modes.
Weekly boards reset every Monday.
Game prizes are in BETA: boards are live, prizes and game points switch on later.
Once game rewards are on, 1 point per 100 score, max 50 game points a day.
No download needed: the app opens in your phone's browser.
Order from the bar, the patio, to go, or scan your table code.
Pay your server or bartender; you still earn points on every check.
The app has 12 languages.
Melody was featured in the L.A. Times.
Free parking is available.
LAX crew get 10% off the check with a badge (dine-in).

How do I join Melody Rewards?

qa.q: Where is Melody?
qa.a: Melody Bar & Grill is at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, in Westchester. Tap Directions in the app to navigate.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call (310) 670-1994, or tap Call in the app.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Hours listed for Melody are Mon–Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat–Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late night.

qa.q: What time does the kitchen close?
qa.a: I don't have a kitchen closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994 before you come late.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: Yes, parking is free, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. Ask staff if you're unsure where to park.

qa.q: Can I walk to Melody from LAX?
qa.a: Yes, it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals, and Melody is about 5 minutes away by car.

qa.q: When is happy hour?
qa.a: Happy hour is 3–6 every day.

qa.q: What are the weekly specials?
qa.a: Mon: half off burgers 11–3. Tue: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Thu: half off sandwiches 11–3. Fri: $3 sliders 11–3. Happy hour is 3–6 daily.

qa.q: What's the Monday special?
qa.a: Mondays are half off burgers from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What's the Tuesday special?
qa.a: Taco Tuesday: $4 classic tacos, $6.99 elevated tacos and $6 margaritas. Taco Tuesday runs 11 AM to midnight.

qa.q: What's the Wednesday special?
qa.a: I don't have a Wednesday special in the app. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What's the Thursday special?
qa.a: Thursdays are half off sandwiches from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What's the Friday special?
qa.a: Fridays are $3 sliders from 11 to 3.

qa.q: What are the elevated tacos on Tuesday?
qa.a: The $6.99 elevated tacos are the Baja Shrimp Taco Melt, the Smash Burger Taco and the Sweet & Spicy Fried Chicken Taco.

qa.q: Which classic tacos are $4 on Tuesday?
qa.a: Chicken, Steak, Carnitas, Dockside Fish, Shrimp, Salmon, Avocado, Beyond and Vegan Carnitas tacos are $4 each on Tuesdays.

qa.q: Can I order Taco Tuesday tacos on other days?
qa.a: No. The Taco Tuesday tacos can only be added to an order on Tuesdays. The regular tacos are available other days.

qa.q: Are margaritas $6 every day?
qa.a: No, the $6 house margarita price is on Tuesdays.

qa.q: What entertainment do you have?
qa.a: Every week there's karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.

qa.q: What nights is karaoke?
qa.a: Karaoke runs weekly, but the app doesn't list the night. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you show sports games?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app also has live LA and California team scores under Sports.

qa.q: Is there a cover charge?
qa.a: I don't have cover charge details for every event. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Can I make a reservation?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info in the app. Please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you host private events?
qa.a: Yes, Melody hosts private events for about 10 to 150 guests. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you do catering or delivery?
qa.a: Catering is available, and delivery is through DoorDash. Call (310) 670-1994 for catering.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Joining is free and takes about 10 seconds in the app. You get 100 welcome points and your gold Melody Rewards card on your phone.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download needed. The app opens in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your home screen. Find it through Instagram @melodylax or the QR code at your table.

qa.q: How do I add it to my home screen?
qa.a: Open the app in your phone's browser and use the browser's Add to Home Screen option. Notifications on iPhone need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).

qa.q: Is Melody Rewards free?
qa.a: Yes, it's free to join. One account per person.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card for Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. You carry your gold Melody Rewards card inside the app.

qa.q: How do I see my rewards card?
qa.a: Tap My Rewards Card in the app to see your card ID, points, next reward and QR code.

qa.q: How do points work?
qa.a: You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip. You also get bonuses for joining, your birthday, referrals and games.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for my visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit, then snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Melody connects its register system, this will be automatic.

qa.q: Are there limits on adding a visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check once, and up to $150 per check. Claims are checked against Melody's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Can I add yesterday's receipt?
qa.a: Yes, you can enter a check dated today or yesterday.

qa.q: Do I earn points when I order from my phone?
qa.a: Yes. You pay your server or bartender like normal and still earn points on every check. Members earn 10 points per $1 on drinks and 10 per $1 on food.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 welcome points when you join.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: $10 off your check. 1,000 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,500 pts: free entrée up to $21.50 (Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries).

qa.q: How many points for a free soft drink or Melody Fries?
qa.a: 250 points.

qa.q: How many points for $10 off?
qa.a: 500 points gets you $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 1,000 points. Pick Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.

qa.q: How many points for a free meal?
qa.a: 1,500 points for a free entrée up to $21.50: any Mac & Cheese, Melody Burger, burrito, tacos or Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. A used or expired code never works again.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date), per member and per phone. A second one shows Come back tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I stack rewards or combine offers?
qa.a: No, there's no stacking. A referral also doesn't stack with another reward on the same visit.

qa.q: Can I get free alcohol with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my points to someone else or cash them out?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred. Points also don't move between restaurants.

qa.q: Do my points expire?
qa.a: I don't have expiry details. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff if you're unsure.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: No. Melody Rewards is one simple points program with no levels.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes, you get +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Tap Text a friend on your member card to send your invite link. Your friend joins with your code and comes in. You get +100 points, and they get 100 welcome points too.

qa.q: When do I get my referral points?
qa.a: They pay once per friend, after that friend's first visit.

qa.q: Can I enter a friend's referral code later?
qa.a: No. You can enter one friend's code once, when you join. It can't be changed later, and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for turning on nearby alerts?
qa.a: Yes, a one-time +100 points. Location and notifications need to be on when you open the app on at least 3 different days spanning at least 7 days. It's added automatically.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for reviewing Melody?
qa.a: Yes, you get +50 points once for telling us how we did in the app.

qa.q: Is there an early-bird bonus?
qa.a: I don't have early-bird details. Ask staff.

qa.q: What is the Just Landed deal?
qa.a: If you landed at LAX in the last 24 hours, show your boarding pass to your server for 10% off your first order today. One per guest per day, and it can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: Is there a discount for airport workers?
qa.a: Melody offers 10% off the check for verified LAX-area workers with a badge or proof of employment, dine-in only. It can't be combined with other promos. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: What is Melody Approach?
qa.a: It's Melody's free arcade flying game: a night dogfight over LA. Pick Campaign (10 levels over a real SoCal route) or Survival (no finish line).

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the ⚡ button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.

qa.q: What is Campaign mode?
qa.a: Campaign has 10 levels of about 45 seconds each. You take off from LAX, fly past Hollywood, Venice Beach and Nalu Vida, Melody and the stadium in Inglewood, the 105 into Compton, then Long Beach and the Queen Mary. Then you land back at LAX. Each level is a little harder, with six boss fights.

qa.q: What is Survival mode?
qa.a: There's no finish line. The game keeps getting harder, and your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How do I score in Melody Approach?
qa.a: You shoot down jets, UFOs, choppers and bosses, and catch Melody's food and music notes. Campaign is ranked by score; Survival by the longest time survived.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, which use limited ammo refilled by ammo crates.

qa.q: How many hits can my plane take?
qa.a: Three hits and your plane goes down, and the game is over. Every enemy attack is warned first.

qa.q: Is there a calm mode without combat?
qa.a: Yes. Pause and tap the ⚔️ button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: Is the game free? Do I need an account?
qa.a: It's free to play, with or without an account. No purchase necessary.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. Games stay free for fun and score.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: There are two weekly boards: Campaign (by score) and Survival (by longest time). Both reset every Monday. Tap Post my score after a flight to put your score on the board.

qa.q: Who wins the weekly prize?
qa.a: Once prizes are on, the top player on each weekly board may win the weekly prize shown in the game (currently Free Melody Fries). The game's rules say how winners are contacted.

qa.q: Are game prizes live yet?
qa.a: Not yet. The game is in BETA: the boards are live for bragging rights, and prizes and game points switch on soon.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The boards reset every Monday. I don't have the exact prize pick time. Ask staff.

qa.q: Do I earn points from the game?
qa.a: Once game rewards switch on, you earn 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date). Right now they're off.

qa.q: Do practice flights count on the leaderboard?
qa.a: No. Practice and test flights don't go on the boards. Scores made with cheats, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: What other games are there?
qa.a: The Melody Games pack has Trivia, Sports Trivia, Melody Word, Melody Mix (a word scramble), Truth or Dare, and the LA Scoreboard. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.

qa.q: How does Melody Word work?
qa.a: It's one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints per word. A new word comes every day at midnight LA time.

qa.q: How does Melody Mix work?
qa.a: It's a timed word scramble: put the letters in order to solve as many words as you can. You get a hint and 3 skips.

qa.q: How do Trivia and Sports Trivia work?
qa.a: Pick a category and answer multiple choice questions on a timer. Faster right answers score more. Sports Trivia lets you pick an LA or California team for a Fan Test and a Fan Rating. You can play solo or pass the phone with 2–6 players.

qa.q: Can I earn points from trivia and word games?
qa.a: Once game rewards are on: Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and the daily Melody Word 3 points (fewer with hints). Up to 10 Games Pack points a day. Right now rewards are off.

qa.q: How does Truth or Dare work?
qa.a: It's a table game for 1–6 players with 3 turns each. You pick Truth or Dare, and anyone can pass. Dares never involve drinking. It's just for fun, with no points.

qa.q: What is the LA Scoreboard and Who wins picks?
qa.a: The LA Scoreboard shows live scores for LA and California teams, for information only (no streams). Who wins? picks are free and just for fun, with no money or wagers. Picks lock when the game starts, and once rewards are on a right pick earns 2 points (max 6 a day).

qa.q: What is Football Squares?
qa.a: Every member can get one free square per game by tapping Get my free square. No purchase is necessary. Staff can add extra squares with a purchase, up to the limit shown on each board. Entries close at kickoff, then numbers are drawn at random. Prizes are shown on each board and are never cash or free alcohol.

qa.q: How do I order from my table?
qa.a: Pick your spot in the app (table number, bar, patio or to go), add items, and send your order. If you scanned a table code, your spot is already picked. Pay your server or bartender like normal.

qa.q: Do I pay in the app?
qa.a: No. You pay your server or bartender like normal, and you still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What does Browse the menu mean if I haven't picked a seat?
qa.a: You can browse the menu anytime. To send an order, pick your seat first. Otherwise just order and pay with your server.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: The app lists Starters, Mac & Cheese, Burgers, Fries, Soups, Tacos & Burritos and Drinks, plus the Tuesday Taco Tuesday menu. Browse the Menu tab for descriptions.

qa.q: What starters do you have?
qa.a: Lemon Pepper Wings, Avocado Toast, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites, Buttermilk Chicken Strips & Fries, Chicken Pot Stickers, Fried Green Beans, Fried Shrimp, Jalapeno Calamari, Lettuce Wraps and Baby Back Ribs & Fries.

qa.q: What Mac & Cheese flavors are there?
qa.a: Lobster, Melody Burger, Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeno, Chicken Parmesan, Parmesan & Mushroom, and House Mac. All use fusilli in a creamy cheese blend, baked to order.

qa.q: What's the Melody Burger?
qa.a: Grilled Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola blue cheese, apple-smoked bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, served with fries. It's $19.25.

qa.q: How much is the Lobster Mac & Cheese?
qa.a: The app shows Lobster Mac & Cheese at $21.50.

qa.q: What kinds of fries do you have?
qa.a: Gilroy Garlic Fries, Melody Fries, Onion Strings, Phat Fries, Philly Cheese Steak Fries and Sweet Potato Fries. Cheese is +$2.00 on Melody Fries and Phat Fries.

qa.q: What soups are there?
qa.a: French Onion, Tomato Bisque and Black Bean, each in a cup or bowl.

qa.q: What tacos and burritos do you have?
qa.a: Tacos (2 per order): Shrimp, Salmon, Carnitas, Chicken, Avocado and Beyond. Burritos: Carnitas, Steak, Chicken and Bean & Cheese. There are also Nachos and a Cheese Quesadilla.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: Yes. The app has Beyond Tacos, Avocado Tacos, Avocado Toast, Fried Green Beans and the Taco Tuesday Vegan Carnitas Taco. Ask staff about ingredients or allergies.

qa.q: What drinks do you have?
qa.a: The app lists margaritas (including Mango), Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, Mimosa, shots and a bucket of 5 beers. Drink prices in the app are previews, so ask your server for current prices.

qa.q: Can I see 3D or real photos of dishes?
qa.a: Yes. Some dishes have a Spin in 3D button, and some have real photos or slow-mo clips. Look for the tags on the menu cards.

qa.q: Do you have nearby alerts or notifications?
qa.a: Optional. Tap Turn on nearby alerts, and your phone asks for permission. They send scheduled reminders like lunch or happy hour. Turn them off in the app or in your phone's Settings.

qa.q: Do you track my location?
qa.a: Only if you turn on nearby alerts, and only while the app is open. Your exact location stays on your phone, and it's never sold or used for ads.

qa.q: What does the app record about me?
qa.a: Each time you open the app (at most once every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary and a random phone ID. It also records your member ID if you joined. It's seen only by the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI and never sold.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages. Look for the language option in the app.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode?
qa.a: The games can run in a kid mode that hides some adult games. I don't have more details, so ask staff.

qa.q: Are kids welcome?
qa.a: Melody is family-friendly by day. I don't have the evening or late-night age policy, so please call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Is there a dress code or a dog policy?
qa.a: I don't have those details. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: Do you take credit cards?
qa.a: Melody lists American Express, Discover, Mastercard and Visa. Ask your server if you have questions.

qa.q: I have a problem with my points or my order. Who can help?
qa.a: Ask your server or a manager, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What is the L.A. Times story about Melody?
qa.a: Melody was featured in the L.A. Times, in a story about the food and culture around LAX. Tap Read the story in the app.

qa.q: How long has Melody been open?
qa.a: Since 1952. It's called the closest bar to LAX.

qa.q: Do I need to pay or buy anything to play games or join?
qa.a: No purchase is necessary to join, play games or enter free Football Squares.
